full_target: For every nonnegative integer n and every nonempty compact E⊆ℝ^n, with I=[0,1] and E×I equipped with the concatenated Euclidean metric, dim_H(E×I)=dim_H(E)+1.

definitions.definition: The pinned Mathlib Lebesgue measure MeasureTheory.volume on the standard real line ℝ.

calculations: Squared concatenated product distance is the sum of squared coordinate distances; coordinate projections are 1-Lipschitz. diam(U×J)≤√(diam(U)^2+diam(J)^2).
